channel.title: The Unfinished Cubby
channel.description:
Finding balance in your many life aspirations.

item.title: A Yarn about The Voice - Dinnawhan & BJ
item.itunes:title: A Yarn about The Voice - Dinnawhan & BJ
item.description: “The Voice” is one of the two parts of the Uluru Statement from the Heart, which was released in 2017 from a convention of 250 Indigenous leaders. The implementation of “The Voice” part of the Uluru Statement is now (2023) underway in the form of a bill before the Australian parliament. On Saturday, 14 October 2023, Australians will vote on a single question to change the Constitution. The question will be about adding words into the Constitution about an Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Voice. ---- This conversation between Dinnawhan, BJ, and Kris was intended as a bit of a bridge between two different ways-of-being that currently exist in Australia. As a person who comes from a culture shaped most heavily by the "colonialist" attitude, this conversation really did allow me to glimpse the world, and what is possible, from a profoundly different, and powerfully hopeful, perspective. ---- Other Links: A Conversation About the First Nations Voice in Parliament : https://medium.com/@medi-muse/response-to-andrew-wallace-mp-about-the-voice-in-parliament-7f8b217c3b3a Uluru Statement from the Heart: : https://ulurustatement.org/the-statement/view-the-statement/ The Unfinished Cubby Podcast : https://rss.com/podcasts/unfinishedcubby/ Unfinished Cubby Patreon : https://www.patreon.com/unfinishedcubby Episode Sponsor : https://cocreations.com.au/ --- Don't forget to vote on Saturday the 14th October!

item.title: Successful Intentional Communities - Jason Hilder
item.itunes:title: Successful Intentional Communities - Jason Hilder
item.description:
Intentionally formed communities are often the fertile seedbeds for holistic, regenerative solutions. What is the dream you would like to manifest?

In this engaging conversation Kris learns about the core principles that make for a successful intentional community.

His guest, Dr Jason Hilder, has freshly completed his PHD titled "We have lived together longer than the average Australian family: Understanding the Intentional Community Living Arrangements"

----------

Jason offers courses to help groups to go through the initial stages of community development, as well as community development advice and support for groups challenged with differences of opinion. Information can be found about this at www.jason.hilder.com.

To find existing communities in Australia and overseas as well as a wealth of information to help community development go to:

the Global Ecovillage Network - ecovillage.org

the Fellowship for Intentional community - www.ic.org

Cohousing Australia - https://www.facebook.com/cohousingaustralia

If anyone is interested in being involved in GEN they can do so via GEN Australia at www.genaustralia.org.au

item.title: Four Secrets for a Healthy Life - Kurt Pennington
item.itunes:title: Four Secrets for a Healthy Life - Kurt Pennington
item.description:
In this awesome conversations with my personal trainer and professional body builder, Kurt Pennington, we cover everything from social media to the many health benefits of breathing through your nose. I didn't get the answer I was looking for on an easy weight loss program.

But Kurt did have some great answers for how to have determination and perseverance in working out, and in life.

- https://kfpfitness.com.au/ -

- https://youtube.com/watch?v=C3UVsPtBY_c&feature=share -

The four "secrets" to determination (not motivation) :

  1. have a "why"

  2. make it routine (morning is king)

  3. be proud, but unsatisfied (appreciate your achievements)

  4. be present (one thing at a time) (a workout can be for a set time - it will end)

item.title: For people who love to work - Louise Flynn
item.itunes:title: For people who love to work - Louise Flynn
item.description:
Work/Life balance for people who love to work.

For some, the best way to build work/life balance is to build a business that focuses on helping the people who value you with products or service that play to your strengths.

Louise shares her story that is still a work-in-progress to reframe her work life to bring more satisfaction to my overall life. Where do you start and what resources can help you?
